title: Paddles, power, and teamwork take center stage as more than 1,000 paddlers join NUSTAR's second Dragon Boat Regatta

blocks.text: NUSTAR Resort Cebu, the first and only integrated resort in the Visayas and Mindanao, recently hosted the second edition of its Dragon Boat Regatta, with the support of the Department of Tourism (DOT), Philippine Sports Commission (PSC), and the Local Government Unit of Cebu City, in partnership with the Philippine Dragon Boat Federation (PDBF) and Philippine Accessible Disability Services, Inc. (PADS). Held on September 19 and 20, 2026, at the NUSTAR Boardwalk, the second NUSTAR Dragon Boat Regatta brought together about 1,500 paddlers, more than double the 621 participants who joined the inaugural regatta last year, representing over 40 teams from […]...
